title: Classify CSP reports before changing policy
method: Synthetic review of 120 reports grouped after inspection. Counts represent reported violations, not unique attacks, affected users or confirmed exploitable XSS defects. Enforcement decisions require separate functional and security tests.
alt: Classify CSP reports before changing policy: Retired integration 80 reports, Required bootstrap 25 reports, Extension-origin noise 15 reports. Illustrative inputs.
